plan.failureSummary: Chatbot functionality is unconfigured or unavailable because an OpenAI API key or active backend service is missing, preventing responses from rendering.
observedIndicators: Agent marked objective as not completable due to missing AI responses
Live screenshot shows Settings modal prompting for an OpenAI API key
DOM analysis (analyzePageText) confirmed zero response message bubbles in the chat frame
10 consecutive test failures recorded in historical flow data

remediationSteps.summary: Configure OpenAI API key or backend service credentials
remediationSteps.details: Ensure a valid OpenAI API key is provided in the application settings or environment variables so briefcase.chat can generate AI responses.

remediationSteps.summary: Re-run test automation once environment is configured
remediationSteps.details: Re-run the test flow after provisioning the required API key/backend setup to verify chatbot responses.

plan.notes: The test failed during page.ai execution because the chatbot on briefcase.chat did not return any responses to user queries. Analysis of the DOM and live screenshot confirmed that no chat bubbles were rendered after sending messages. The Settings modal indicates an OpenAI API key is required or the limit was reached, causing the agent to mark the objective as not completable. This issue has occurred in 10 consecutive test runs.
